decisions.reason: The updated design concerns the separate PowerPoint deliverable and does not change the graphic-bullet requirements for the Word templates.
The source changes the design input for the PowerPoint template but does not change the contents, version designation, or archive format of the versioned Word-template package.
An updated PowerPoint design does not alter the required style set or its coverage across Word templates.
The source does not address legacy-to-new Word-template copy-paste behavior or resolve its existing ambiguity.
The updated PowerPoint design does not change the Word-template paragraph, Enter-key, or line-break requirements.
The source does not specify any change to the approved theme colors or color availability in the Word templates.
The PowerPoint design update does not affect Tab-controlled hierarchy behavior in Word lists.
The source does not change the requirement for stable Word-table layouts during pasted-content workflows.
The request to inspect whether the updated PowerPoint design changes the budget is specific to the PowerPoint work and does not modify the earlier Word-template due-diligence deliverable.
The updated PowerPoint design does not entail a change to internal spacing in the Word-template content areas.
The source does not change the established row-extension workflow in the Board Meeting Word template.
The PowerPoint design update does not affect fixed margins or clipping prevention in the Vejledning Word template.
